purpose: Audit-directed known-target experiment: separate exact exponential-surrogate validity from learning its direction with 96 paired reward queries in dimensions 6, 64, 512 and 16384. Primary metric is post-warmup ratio MSE divided by paired MC MSE; no diffusion or real-RL claim. Also verify the affine antithetic identity and document the raw-M1 in-sample diagnostic degeneracy.
